work_item: B04 keyed comparison of JSON string tables with two-sided source locations through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: This continuation did not request test or runtime-route verification; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableCompare -> ports::json_table_compare -> JsonTableComparisonReport artifact
wrapper_schema: Exactly {"left":{"columns":[string,...],"rows":[[string,...],...]},"right":...}; duplicate/unknown fields and nonstring cells are rejected.
comparison_rules: Both sides require identical decoded column names in the same order, 1..256 columns, rectangular rows and at most 4096 rows.
The selected key column must exist and have unique exact-string values on both sides; keys and cells are not normalized or converted.
Left rows are reported in source order as removed rows or changed non-key cells; right-only rows follow in source order as additions.
Each change carries left/right JSON Pointers, byte ranges and SHA-256 digests; changed cells also carry exact string values.
Duplicate decoded JSON keys and table headers, invalid shapes, duplicate keys and bounded-input/output overflows return typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
